method: four deterministic traces; every step is inputs -> identity -> computation -> verdict; each citation names case, docket, page, file and sha256, verified against the held file at build time

steps.name: Primary inputs & SHA-256

inputs.what: W.E. Denison demand letter, Dkt 284, quoting Thyssenkrupp invoice #5000875502
Order granting fees and costs, Dkt 423

steps.note: Both numbers are read from the bytes above; neither is transcribed from prose.

steps.name: Rule / arithmetic identity applied
steps.rule: A ratio between two amounts stated in two documents is a division; it is not a finding about what either amount was FOR.
steps.identity: ratio = fees_award / invoice_amount ; difference = fees_award — invoice_amount

steps.name: Algorithmic verdict
follows: the fee award stated on Dkt 423 p.12 is 87.0491x the invoice amount stated on Dkt 284
the two amounts differ by exactly $194,483.93
both documents are held and hash-verified, so both numbers are reproducible from bytes
does_not_follow: that the fees were incurred because of, or were measured by, the $2,260.15 repair
that the award is proportionate, disproportionate, reasonable or unreasonable
that any party's conduct caused the difference

inputs.what: ICA Notice of Entering Case on Calendar, filed 28-OCT-2026

inputs.value: Statement of Jurisdiction original 16-NOV-2026 / current 09-NOV-2026; Opening Brief original 14-DEC-2026 / current 07-DEC-2026

steps.name: Rule / calendar identity applied
steps.rule: Two statements of the same deadline differ by a whole number of days; the panel's own advisory says HRAP dates prevail over panel dates.

steps.name: Formula / calendar math shown
work: panel.current (9-NOV-2026, 7-DEC-2026) == notice values exactly (0 days delta)
9-NOV-2026 is a Monday; 7-DEC-2026 is a Monday

steps.name: Algorithmic verdict
follows: the JIMS panel's ORIGINAL column is exactly 7 days later than the notice for both dates
the panel's CURRENT column equals the notice exactly
the panel carries the court's own advisory that HRAP dates prevail, so the panel does not assert its original values as operative
does_not_follow: which date governs, whether either date binds, or what satisfies either date
that the deadlines were extended or moved (no order in the library says so)

traces.title: ICA Dkt 13 motion to withdraw vs ICA Dkt 19 p.3 flyleaf

inputs.what: Revere & Associates, LLLC's motion for leave to withdraw as counsel for appellant, filed 09-OCT-2026
inputs.value: motion filed; no ruling on it in the ICA docket

inputs.what: the trial court's order granting withdrawal, attached as Exhibit 1 to Dkt 13
Amended Record on Appeal, index note

steps.name: Rule / set identity applied
steps.rule: A motion is an act of a party; a ruling is an act of a court. Count the appeal-docket rows that are rulings on the motion.
steps.identity: rulings_on_dkt13 = |{row in CAAP-26-0000625 : row answers Dkt 13}|

steps.name: Formula / counting shown
work: appeal docket rows in the library: 20
rows that reference the withdrawal motion: 1 (the motion itself, Dkt 13)
rows that are an appeal-court order on it: 0
trial-court order granting withdrawal: 1 (trial Dkt 484, inside Dkt 13 p.10)
steps.code: len([r for r in appeal_rows if 'order' in r.code.lower() and r.docket > 13]) == 0

steps.name: Algorithmic verdict
follows: the trial court granted withdrawal on 07-OCT-2026 (trial Dkt 484, reproduced at Dkt 13 p.10)
the appeal court received a motion for leave to withdraw on 09-OCT-2026 (Dkt 13)
no appeal-court ruling on that motion is held in the library (0 rows)
the amended record's flyleaf says it now names attorneys and removed Pro Se
does_not_follow: that appellate counsel has withdrawn, or that the appellant is unrepresented before the ICA
that the flyleaf note is a ruling, or that it supersedes Dkt 13
any consequence for the appeal schedule (Dkt 13 states none)

traces.title: 1RC Dkt 496 NA filed 04-SEP-2026 vs the 495-row Record on Appeal cutoff

inputs.what: certified trial-court notice of appeal, Dkt 496
Record on Appeal register (ICA Dkt 15), pp.5-195

steps.name: Rule / membership test applied
steps.rule: Is docket 496 an element of the integers the register prints (1..495)?

steps.name: Formula / set membership and date order shown
work: register docket numbers = 1..495 (495 entries, header '495 record(s) total')
Dkt 496 filing date 04-SEP-2026 is 49 days BEFORE the register's last entry 23-OCT-2026

steps.name: Algorithmic verdict
follows: the notice of appeal carries trial docket number 496
the register printed in the Record on Appeal ends at 495
the missing number is dated 49 days earlier than the register's last entry
does_not_follow: that the Record on Appeal is incomplete, or that anything was omitted improperly
that the appeal is timely or untimely
